verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss documents a REST API that can create a lead ('Send in a lead'), and its own lead distribution feature can route leads by round robin or rules. There is no evidence of an MCP server, of writing company data to a record, or of setting an owner explicitly through the API. Missing for 10: MCP server, API write of company/enrichment fields, explicit owner-assignment endpoint, end-to-end agent workflow evidence, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner

citations.quote: Send in a lead or an event related to a lead.
Follow Up Boss provides a simple [REST API](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_state_transfer) that allows developers to integrate their applications quickly.
round robin, first to claim, and rules by price or ZIP code
